text: This place is super cute. I came here for breakfast before work and ate in. I had a savory crepe, the Americano I believe, and a macchiato. It was ready pretty quickly, and was very good. The crepe is on the larger side; I managed to eat most of it but probably shouldn't have. The space is well-lit because of the windows, and on the smaller side. I'm not sure if there's another floor with more seating.
Great food and quick delivery make this one our our pandemic favorites. My family loves the burgers, gyros, and chicken tenders. And the curly fries - always get curly fries!

I hope that anyone who reads the review by Donna Q ignores it because she obviously has an axe to grind. My wife and I have been customers, no, friends with the Gambol's family for over 15 years. I say friends and family because if you come to Gambol's that is how you will be treated. That goes for staff and customers alike. This place is like Cheers where everybody knows your name. We celebrate birthdays, weddings, funerals etc together. We all look out for each other so Donna Q keep your venom to yourself. Love you Carole & Mike.

I highly suggest Green Lemon for any catering needs. Ray at Green Lemon was very helpful with multiple orders. He was flexible and communicated very well. Ray went above and beyond to ensure my order was correct, on time and that my group was satisfied with the outcome. The catering at Green Lemon is very affordable but so tasty! Will continue to order catering from them moving forward.

Ray's email is rbeach@eatgreenlemon.com and phone is 813-601-7011 if you need any catering needs!

Thank goodness this gem in the Black Pearl, Singleton's has reopened. I had an amazing order of their Vietnamese chicken sliders. loaded with chicken, pickled carrots, and jalapenos. I paid $10 bucks for 4 sliders and a drink and walked away with change. The portion size could have easily fed 2 people, but not in the mood to share I managed to devour them all solo. Can't wait till Saturday for their authentic Pho. So glad to see Bo and Laura back at it with their easy smiles and awesome hospitality!
This is quite possibly the best restaurant in PA. Wild portion sizes for so cheap. Gigantic fries is a god like creation. Get the whole menu and you won't regret it.

Stopped in to the Factory while visiting family in Franklin and stumbled upon Honest Coffee Roasters (HCR) as we walked in the building. Love the open space with high ceilings. 

I thoroughly enjoyed my large Roosevelt (slightly spiced and wonderful) and my wife enjoyed her medium Cuban (made with sweetened condensed milk). We bought a bag of the Montanita coffee to take home with us as well - look forward to trying it in the near future.

While the drinks were delightful, my favorite thing about HCR was the ability to view the coffee roasting in action. You can tell it is a meticulous process as the employees monitor temperatures, amounts, and other variables throughout the roasting process. That attention to detail is what will keep me coming back when I visit Franklin in the future!
Very nice and clean area. I only came in to get a tiramisu to-go, but it was incredibly tasty and authentic. I would at least recommend the dessert!

I'm so glad we could reserve a table in advance here on yelp, thank you! We have no wait are seated at a beautiful table on the water with live music. Love the happy hour half price froze.  The menu looked fabulous it was so hard to choose. The Caesar salad was a Normas grilled shrimp spectacular, oyster poboy was good, And I understand why the corn pudding is such a hit, it was delicious. Delicious food, beautiful atmosphere, great service, good friends and a nice time!

I should know to stop giving McDonald's a chance. It never fails that I either sit in the drive-thru for an hour, get told to sit in a reserve spot then sit their for an hour, or they just forget half your food. This time they just decided to not give us any fries. 
McDonald's is a joke and it isn't just this store because I've experienced these events at all the surrounding stores. This entire company needs to get it together, but please go ahead and blame it on COVID-19 like everyone else.
I thought this place was the sh*t, personally.  Gyros were f***ing great, zucchini fries were great too.  Good fast casual spot.

Went here for happy hour and ordered four different small plates & a cocktail with a friend. Surprisingly reasonably priced with delicious food  The interior was so modern & old fashioned at the same time. Wonderful place to go with friends for happy hour. Excited to go back for actual dinner!

Had to review this restaurant as husband and I went for his birthday and had the BEST meal of our life! We were sat at a romantic table for 2. Lighting perfectly dim. We love fine dining and dressing up so we knew we had to come here. We started with a bottle of bubbly (Prosecco) which was refreshing. We decided we wanted to try the tasting menu which has 7 courses and OH MY. Let me tell you. Each plate presented with perfect timing. We also added the filet on top of the menu-best decision ever. I think our favorite was the pork, WOW. So juicy and cooked perfectly. Everything was incredible from start to finish. Thank you for such a memorable night. Will highly recommend to anyone we know visiting NOLA!

This was a fun pour it yourself wine stop! They had several options for people like me that don't drink dry wine. I also like that they had different price ranges. 

The atmosphere was sophisticated casual. Service was friendly!

One of the few fine dining restaurants in the area.  And it's not typical Florida cuisine.  Classic French food served by the lovely owner gracefully.  Everything is delicious.  I always get the sweetbreads.  Where else are you going to get those in Florida, lol.  Go and enjoy a pleasant meal.

We love Donatos but unfortunately the last 3 times we've ordered delivery, the order was at least 30 minutes late. The most recent time was tonight. Our order was due at 6:30 and is currently an hour late. We called the first time to no answer. The second call got us an answer and we were told it was "on the way."  Promptly after ending the call we received an email update saying the pizza was in route. It seems pretty clear that our order was forgotten. We're still waiting for our pizza that we ordered over two hours ago  :(

This place was not on my radar but running btw mtgs ran in here for lunch. Gumbo was excellent and my catfish was great.  Big servings.  The space is big, lots of parking and glad to support a work force training program for young adults.

Not sure if it's more the restaurant's fault or GrubHub's. I placed an order for at around 4:45pm. Estimated delivery 5:30-5:50. 6:15 came and still no updates. I called GrubHub and they said 20 more min. Had to call again because food didn't arrive until almost 7. 

Sushi rolls were so sparse and little portions of fish. Tuna did not seem fresh. Also I asked for diet Coke and recieved Pepsi. Special rolls are small.

I have worked in restaurants for almost 10 years, especially half of them in a sushi restaurant. The quality is not good. Over two hours + over $40 later, and kinda dissapointed. Sort of the only option for sushi, but whatever.
Order was wrong and when called to get it fixed they never came. This isn't the first time this has happened. Very disappointed with Ochatto.
Very nice owners, Clean building, Food quality good, Very big serving,  Well worth the money.
There's a sandwich they had on their food truck that I miss terribly and loved a lot, but the bumble brie is a close second! I love the Apple honey combo!

Definitely 5 stars . My rehearsal dinner was here last fall for my wedding - we had the room upstairs reserved for us with menus and it really was perfect . The setting , the food and service top notch!  I've been here several times before and it's always a favorite of mine in New Hope !

The Melting Pot is my family's go-to restaurant for birthdays and any special occasions and it NEVER disappoints. On our most recent visit, we had the server Nick for the second time and he was great. The menu always has new, seasonal specials in addition to the usual staples so we enjoy getting some favorites, such as the dark chocolate sea salt, and trying new items each time. As strange as it sounds, our absolute favorite food is broccoli cooked in the mojo style. Since it is a 4 course meal and rather expensive, come hungry in order to get the full experience and value. Apparently the summer is a very slow time so they have lots of deals-- consider going then to drop the cost.

The 1st chef we almost had was very angry, thankfully we had to move to another table due to the cooking area not working, the chef we ended up with  was awesome & our server (Sarah) was very good.   BUT...the place needs a good scrubbing; the floor was dirty, the bathroom was disgusting; the table we 1st sat the wall was nasty with food splatters. Food was tasty as long as I didn't look around at the filth.

Food good but not super great. Bread on ciopino and lobster roll not crispy. Lobster pasty needed more sauce. Fried platter appetizer was great (calamari shrimp oysters). Friendly staff cold beer great view environment). Will go back and try other dishes.

Order two small bowls for lunch. Filling I liked mine better with brown rice and greens I like vegetables. Fish tasted great I'm picky can't have fish taste. Delivered by Grub Hub took 35 minutes we're 15 minutes away at lunch time, fast. Nice to treat yourself now.
Outstanding food and service.  Shrimp tacos, chowder and gumbo.  Enough for 2! Enjoy.

I love calzones and this place did not let me down! The crust was soft but not soggy. I had a modified garden calzone and was one of the best I have ever had. The sauce was the perfect too!!! Plus the guy at the counter was quick to greet us, explained how everything worked and was patient with all our questions. Only criticism is the acoustics - the all metal industrial vibe is great but can get so loud.

Now open for inside dining. Tables are about 5 ' apart. We got there around noon and the restaurant was nearly empty. We got the usual good food and speedy service from two waitresses.

Get there before the word is out and El Sur gets really crowded.
Great food. The fig burger is very flavorful the chicken tiki masala doesn't come with enough rice. It feels like you're eating soup
Love this hidden gem. Sushi always fresh, not crowded and chefs always give a personalized dish that makes it such a great experience!

Large servings and delicious food galore! You can't go wrong with Mona's Cafe when you're looking for decently priced Mediterranean food that can feed you more than once. Their fresh made pita is served by the handful with every order. The hummus is delicious. 

I typically get the Chicken Shawarma and the stuffed grape leaves. The salad that comes with the shawarma is always tasty and fresh, and the hummus is definitely one of my favorites. Their menu is pretty lengthy with tons of options, which can be slightly overwhelming if you have no idea what you are looking for. I'm pretty basic when it comes to Mediterranean, but they do have some options for the more experienced folks!

For COVID, they are offering takeout/pick up only. They had an online ordering system (which does charge a couple dollars extra for service fees) or you can give them a call to place your order!
My go to spot for pho! Affordable and amazing. They're still doing takeout so please make sure to support them during the shelter in place :)

I had the Good Morning Darling Breakfast with smothered potatoes, grits, hot sausage, and a biscuit. The owner served me and I got the sense that she really takes pride in her food. I asked her advice on ordering and she was kind enough to do a half grits/ half smothered potatoes. The potatoes were tender and flavorful. By far the best meal I've had in NOLA.
Not just your average bar food!  This place was a very pleasant surprise! Excellent food, great service, good atmosphere! We will definitely be back!!

Cool vibe and the waitstaff was very nice and friendly. We made reservations and were seated immediately even a few minutes earlier than our reservation. We stated with drinks and our waiter brought us bread. I got the lions mane and it was amazing. My husband got the Paloma and said it was very good. We started off with the fire wood chili oysters. Oh my. We could have just ordered these and been happy. They were perfectly cooked. Then for dinner I got the redfish and my husband got the fried oyster BLT. The redfish was good but needed a bit more flavor in my opinion. My husband said his sandwich was unlike anything he has ever had before. "A wonderful Cajun twist on an American classic" were his exact words. We also got the Mac n cheese casserole - YUM! We then ended our meal with the brown sugar pound cake. It was fantastic.

Great shrimp po boy.  Very cool
Little hole in the wall.  Everyone was very friendly.

Absolutely fabulous experience. LOVED our dinner. The waiter, Felix, was so knowledgeable about the menu and explained every dish to us (we didn't know much about fish). We tried his recommendations and they were phenomenal! We'll be going back for sure.
It's our go to taco joint. Sooo good and fairly priced! Great staff too. I always get carnitas for tacos, salad or burritos . The quest is on point too!!

This place was fantastic, I usually don't give reviews because I don't like being one of those people, but they were friendly, were very honest and did wonders cleaning everything. Everything was superrr clean and super well made. The drinks were amazing, my mom really enjoyed their chocolate milkshake and pumpkin spice one, the cashier that recommended it to us today was very very respectful and kind. As well for the other employees everything felt peaceful and felt like a really loving place. Definitely will be back! And the prices are amazing too!! Got three burgers, and three drinks under $50!! That's insane, thanks for an amazing customer experience!!

My uncle & I tried this restaurant for the 1st time last night. The hostess was friendly and seated us quickly after we arrived. It all went downhill after that. We waited at our table about 20 minutes before any employee visited us, and that was just a man with chips & salsa who didn't question why we'd been there so long without beverages. The hostess finally noticed that and asked of anyone had taken our drink order and got us some drinks herself. Then we waited about 15-20 more minutes before anyone returned to our table to take our order. After waiting for our food order for some time, we asked our server if something was wrong with our food & she said it would be at least 15 more minutes but that she'd check on it. She never returned. After being there for over an hour without dinner, we finally asked the hostess to let us pay for our drinks & chips so we could leave, but she told us we could just go. In all this time, several different employees walked by our table, but no one stopped to see if we needed anything. If there was a manager, we never saw them. We will not return and absolutely don't recommend this restaurant.

The drinks where not good ! We waited over an hour for our dinner and they were not busy ! Our food when it came was not good ! The shrimp cevesa , had 3 shrimp ! The chips were stale ! Not good at all ! Very disappointing
We get these cheesesteaks every time we are in Philadelphia. They're about $9 each so a tad on the pricy end if you ask me but the portion is huge.

Due to a server using disgusting profanity in reference to my family sitting down, which includes 3 children 10 & under, we will not be visiting any of your establishments. Absolutely revolting behavior.

We used to really love this place. Great food and service. But lately everything has gone down hill. They consistently forget or mess up orders and the quality isn't as good as it used to be. Their meatballs in particular are rubbery and bland. 

This most recently delivery order, they forgot part of our it, said they'd bring it, and never came. I called 2 hours later and they said they forgot. 

Skip this place. Downingtown isn't exactly hurting for Italian joints.

Poor customer service! Whoever just served me had an extremely poor attitude. He threw my change into my bag of food, which is extremely unsanitary and just generally rude. Additionally I wanted to get some honey after he went back inside. After he finally came back to the window and I asked for some honey, he says "you waited 2 hrs for just some honey," when in actuality it was one minute. In case you forgot, you're in a service industry.
Prepare to leave hungry. This place is expensive and you barely get anything to eat. It's all hype. Avoid this place. Much better options out there.
A cozy place for relaxed lunch. Excellent quality pasta and sandwiches; which motivate me to come back.

If you like hot dogs - these are ok.  After all - pretty hard to mess up a hot dog.  The variety in the toppings is ok.  Had the Mac n cheese dog.  The Mac n cheese was
Kind of greasy (although not as cheesy for some reason) and made the hot dog bun soggy.
We have had this place a few times and it is incredible. We love everything they have to offer.

Shells is always a good choice for seafood. They have everything on the menu and are well known for their pasta dishes. The pricing is really reasonable compared to just about every one else. Survive is fast and efficient. They have been around the Tampa bay area for a long time and  really know what they are doing and do a great job at it.

Attended a drag show here and our family had an amazing time. The queens were fierce, the service was awesome and the atmosphere was very fun. However, the food Is TERRIBLE! Not one person in my group enjoyed their brunch. We had a blast but how do you mess up brunch? Lol though I would definitely pay the price anyway for the awesome show.
Some of the best po buys I've ever had!! I even had a grilled shrimp po-boy and it was better then the fried shrimp po-boy!! Delicious

Great spot!  Eclectic and fun. Perfect atmosphere for adults but not much for the kiddos. I would make this a weekend spot with my wife if we lived closer. Food was fantastic but certainly an adult palette required.

I had a great experience at the Good Dog Bar- food was awesome, and so was the bartender. I think his name was Zach. I wasn't sure what to get on the menu and I told him I wanted something that would be easy on my stomach. He had the kitchen whip me up a grilled chicken sandwich. It was the best bread on a chicken sandwich ever. I cannot wait to go back. I also told the bartender I needed a light drink that will help me last through the night while getting together with old friends. Zach introduced me to the White Claw drink Mango flavored which was excellent. I hope my friend tipped Zach amazingly because he deserved it. My friend and I will be back and we will make sure we to eat at the bar.

Let's start with a clean restaurant. Very organized, spotless, and nice staff!

We ordered the breakfast burrito but substituted the sausage for bacon at the suggestion of our waiter and glad we did!  The chipotle sour cream was a really great touch. 

Then we had the sirloin steak and eggs, steak cooked medium rare. Cooked perfectly and delicious. 

To top it all off, fresh squeezed orange juice and in-house brewed iced tea. 

This place is on our list of really good food, and a menu to be explored more!
Fantastic service and delicious food!!!! Popped in for breakfast on our way to Nola for Mardi Gras and so glad I did!!!
Seminole heights got that fire! If you can handle the heat, coops fury is the way to go. Tenders are juicyyyyyy and they aren't skimpy on portions.

This was our "go-to" place when it opened, probably fifty years ago.  Very pleasant atmosphere with on-site owners, long-time friendly servers, and decent, sometimes really good, food  Now we go there primarily because it is close buy.   It seems to have changed hands a few times since the original owners sold it.  These changes have not been for the better.  Staffing seems to be a problem.  Except for the manager (perhaps, the owner), you rarely see the same face twice.  While pleasant, new servers are inexperienced and "I'm sorry" seems to be their most used phrase.  The manager's(?) attitude almost borders on surly and the homey greeting is missing.  Breakfasts tend to be very good.  Recent dinner included decent Manhattan Clam, salad which consisted of iceberg, 2 slivers of carrot, 1 sliver of onion, and 2 cherry tomatoes and very good honey mustard dressing.  Stuffed seafood trio (flounder, shrimp, mushroom), had an abundance of stuffing (little crab, much filler), well cook flounder; 2 shrimp inside stuffing which  included a tail that had not been removed; and one small button mushroom.  Puddings were very good.
There are many diners and fast food restaurants in this area. Several of the newer ones have not survived.  I think that the West survives because of it loyal followers.
Delicious the brisket chili is the best but so far everything has been amazing not a single disappointment.  This place is small however...

Big fans of Jay's. It's our local cheesesteak place, and Jay and his crew are impressively supportive of local charities and non profits. Today, we shared a Jay's favorite on a pretzel roll, a smart italian hoagie on a regular roll, and fries. Jay's favorite was great, as usual. The hoagie had good flavor but was dry. We added our own condiments, and enjoyed it. Note: they don't skimp on meat and cheese, but they don't overstuff, either. The fries: bleh-mushy and not tasty. Can we improve on the fries, please? 
Service, price, and speed: great.

We were driving through Tucson and were craving Indian cuisine. We stumbled upon this gem and were pleasantly pleased. We ordered the butter chicken, vegetable samosa, and garlic naan. Pick up was simple and our food was hot when we got home. So delicious!

I absolutely adore this place, the workers are so kind and charismatic. We have gone multiple times in a week and the food is just as yummy every time. Well priced and feels like you're family. Couldn't recommend this place or their orange juice enough!!!

Went for lunch today . Arrived at 1.30 after the lunch hour rush. There were a few tables empty in the casual dining area, however the hostess said there were none available. There was no one waiting so we asked why we couldn't sit at one of the empty tables..The hostess was rude. Ignored our request and when we asked again she said the tables had to be set. The restaurant had emptied out at this point, so there was nothing stopping her from setting the table or seating us then bringing the settings.
Her whole attitude was disgusting. It was only when I mentioned that I would talk to one of the owners did she jump up off her chair and set the table.
Food was good but wouldn't rush back. One's culinary experience starts once you walk through the door.

As a food enthusiast I was very excited to test the advertised steak burgers and specialty shakes, and to be honest I have no clue how I am writing this review right now because I'm at a loss for words. People sometimes ask me "If you had one last meal what would it be?"  ha ha well yeah based of my experience it's now going to be a frisco melt , large fry, and a limited time eggnog milk shake. I can't get enough of this place and their friendly staff! 10/10 recommend. Very good.

Unorganized, stale foods and iccy ice on top of the ice cream. Leads me to think they never change it. Ordering ice cream or a shake? Forget it if you're in a rush, they'll need about 17-25 minutes on just one. Awful service.

The Crack Crab sauce is amazing. It is definitely worth it for great seafood. I recently had an issue with a delivery order So I called and they were apologetic. It was an inconvenience but I went back and they did make it right.

Went here for the first pandemic date lunch Mrs V and I have had in a while! Twisted shrimp is delicious but overpriced (think buffalo wings meets shrimp). Salads and burgers excellent! High quality meat used in both and seasonings/dressings were excellent! Drinks overpriced as well but delicious! We didn't try the steaks. it the menu said many were aged more than 90days so definitely want to revisit!

Ummmm black bean soup? Yes please! I was not expecting to order soup but am so glad I did and highly recommend it. I also had the chicken fajita sandwich and that was a perfect combo of crunchy and flavor. My friend ordered the carnitas tacos, while the carnitas melted in your mouth, the tacos had a little too much lettuce. The 4 is given for great food and overall decent (not super attentive) service.

Definitely lives up to its description as a family style restaurant with a very casual, friendly atmosphere. Quite a few TVs hung throughout  to entertain the children.  You will feel comfortable upon taking your seat.  The service was excellent and quick.  We all got pizzas which were priced extremely reasonably.  The thin crusted pizzas on offer  had some original names and combinations of ingredients. The flavors were not overpowering, but rather a mild meld.  I personally would have enjoyed a few more dashes of oregano, basil, or rosemary in the sauce or in the olive oil base.   Overall, it delivers on what it advertises.  I would return.

Finally, a place that sells high quality AUTHENTIC Salvadoran/Honduran food!

Being half Salvadoran and half Honduran, eating at El Bocado was more than I could have asked for! Pupusas revueltas were done well, jugo de nance was perfect, and the pastelitos were delicious.

Growing up eating enchiladas, no not mexican enchiladas but actual Salvadoran/Honduran enchiladas was the best but no one ever understood what they were but alas, El Bocado has delivered with authentic enchiladas that remind me of home. 

If you want to try AUTHENTIC (not white washed) Central American food--this is the spot. The owner is also super sweet and provided excellent service. The food and service is well worth the visit and I am excited to finally have a place in philly that tastes like home! 

Buen provecho everyone!!!
Sauce is sooo yummy! I come here a lot with my friends and usually order a salad. They have a lot of unique options and the price is pretty good.
Awesome newer place oceanfront. Scott is incredibly knowledgeable with the food and the menu

Not much I can say about this restaurant. The poached egg was perfect, the home fries we crispy but a little under seasoned, the gravy was out of this world! I think this little spot is definitely a gem and I would recommend to anyone old and young!

This is a staple at our house when we are in the mood for burgers dine in or carry out. My boyfriend always gets the One Bad Pig and I try different ones. Love the calamari fries too. Good beer selection in house too.

I love love love PF Chang's!! The food is always amazing. And the service is great. I love EVERYTHING in the menu. The Cecilia's steamed pork dumplings are to die fooor!! Their cocktails are delish as well, and their bartenders are ever so friendly. Plus I so love the ambiance of this place. I recommend this to anyone that has never been to a PF Chang's or just trying to get fancier Chinese dinner.

I have read some of the comments and I'm quite surprised how many people experience something bad about this place. I have seen this place get busy, and I do notice that there are a lot of seats open but people needed to wait 30 mins to get seated, maybe cause their understaffed? I always just sit at the bar and the service for me has always been great and consistent..

The food was delicious! I'll start with that. My husband and I always have artichoke when it's on the menu and this was probably the best we've ever had. Charred to perfection and served with a delicious garlic aioli. My husband had the rib eye which was well over the 11ounce they describe on the menu and cooked perfectly medium rare. I had the halibut and it was beautifully presented, light and flakey with a house made tartar sauce. 

The service was what stood out even more than the food. We sat at the bar and due to covid, were the only people at the bar. But JR (bartender) made us feel right at home. He was accommodating and helpful. Thank you for a beautiful first night out. Can't wait to come back! Cheers!

This is a must try place for anyone looking for a change from typical beach bar food or fast food. As one who grew up in Hawaii local plate lunches are a main staple and I can honestly say that Aloha To Go checks all the boxes for Ono-licious island style food at a very affordable price. They have two convenient locations here in Pinellas County and both serve up excellent food with an extra helping of Aloha to make you feel right at home.
During this weird covid-19 time I want to do my part to help support this wonderful owner Jen and her amazing staff by ordering meals to go. 
Trust me if your looking for a good affordable option for lunch or dinner please check out this place, you can thank me later.

I don't know Indian food, but I know good food and this place has it! Wow! What a diamond in the rough and completely unexpected pleasure. My wife and I went there tonight for my birthday and I couldn't have asked for a better celebration meal. We got a chicken app, amazing, and we each got a chicken entree. If I could pronounce whatever we had I would at least try to spell it phonetically, but I won't because the point is: go, get something you don't understand, and get ready to be amazed. This place is comfort food from half way around the world, but it can put even your favorite biscuits and gravy recipe to the test any day! Enjoy! P.S. - They just got their liquor license! Happy b-day to me!

I order breakfast from here a day or two out of the week. Normally it's always almost correct. Today I went and I didn't get what I paid for was over charged and the person who took my order basically told me that what I called and placed. I have never spent 35$ on potatoes until today. I will not be going back to the diner again. And the food was cold when I got it. Mind you I only stay 2 mins away from the restaurant. Save your self the trouble and go some place else

Ate here several times while in Nashville for work over the course of a couple weeks.  It was on my drive to Publix from the hotel and had great curb appeal.  It is set in a home turned restaurant dwelling.  Menu has several great options but I stuck with tacos each time I visited.  Was never disappointed.  However, I did order their avocado fries each time as they were so delicious that I had to have them again.  When my wife came up to visit for one of the weekends this is the place brought here for one of the dinners, and she was equally impressed with their offerings.  Will be returning the next time I pass through Nashville.

La Piedad is one of my favorites! You couldn't ask for more with the tasty and cheap food and the great people.

I've been going to La P since college and it hasn't changed one bit since the first day I went. Though I usually just get the super basic tacos, we went with the Texan Fajitas and a Chicken Chimichanga today. The fajitas were great but the chicken was a bit dry on the Chimichanga. Just load on the guac and the pico de gallo and it tastes great! 

When it isn't mid-afternoon (or maybe when it is) add on a frozen strawberry marg, they're to die for! During Covid, they've done a great job of social distancing and sanitizing tables after people use them. If you have the time in Broad Ripple, I would definitely recommend stopping in at La P!

We had our small wedding dinner (23 people) here in the upstairs room. It was absolutely beautiful! They set up our tables in a U shape so everyone was able to see and talk to each other. We ALL had a great time!! Our servers Elle and Kenny were wonderful! There wasn't a time that anyone of us needed anything. They were so attentive it was great!! The food was just as amazing too. From the salad and appetizers to our 4 main courses... no one left hungry!! It was all delicious!! If your looking to have a private dinner party, personal/ business the Taphouse is the place!! Carol and Rich are the best hosts ever! They made our dinner party MY BEST DAY EVER!!!
Worst service and food. Took forever even to get a menu. Never came back to table to check if meal was ok. How could a steakhouse even serve a steak like that. Could not even cut it.

My boyfriend and I visited Rosalita's tonight,  for the 1st time since the Covid shutdown. The service was great! Food was great! It was encouraging that all staff were wearing masks. We ate at the bar on patio. We were disheartened that it was obvious that social distancing was NOT being practiced at the outside bar. The bartop was nasty & sticky.  We were hoping to see one person designated to spray down menus, tabletops, chairs, etc. However, NONE of that was happening.  We likely will NOT be back until more visible cleanliness practices and social distancing at the patio bar is adhered to.

This is a go to place for the people at the car dealership, Indy Auto Man. The place is few minutes from the car dealership and if you are a sales consultant the speedy service is crucial. And on top of speedy service place provides excellent Gyros, falafels, hummus, and salads. During Covid this place is not as full as it used to be, but it is operated well with the same level of service.
Amazing pizza spot!! Late night college pizza spot, has saved me so many times from hunger. I'm a senior at SLU and I love Picklemans.
Just passing through and got lunch here. Amazing birria, just what I wanted. Husband got a burro and I got tacos.  Staff is very kind, and have currently 3 outdoor tables if you want to eat there.

One of our favorite restaurants in Tampa. So authentic. And the ambiance is remarkable. The staff is friendly and always help with any questions and suggestions. We love recommending this hidden gem to everyone.

Masala Kitchen has become a favorite amongst many of the center city locals with dozens of kati rolls, multiple levels of flavors, employee discounts, and hot off the grill meat for the rice bowls. Having ordered almost every single roll (ranging from about $4-6), my favorite is still the masala chicken and the aloo (potato) rolls, and you have to get them extra spicy. The pepper/veggie versions tend to a bit too salty for my taste and rob flavor from the meat. In addition to the classic rolls and bowls, Masala kitchen also offers lassi and eclectic sodas, but it's prepackaged and would prefer freshly made versions instead.

Overall, this is a great spot if you're hungering for 2-3 rolls and it should only set you back for about $15, which is a great price for Center City.

Food: 4 stars
Price: 4 stars
Ambiance: 3 stars
Service: 3-4 stars
Nice place, small low key, but awesome chicken fingers and I heard the shrimp tacos were awesome. Owner is really nice, thanks!!

We came in on a weekday. It was dead but that didn't stop our waitress from giving us incredible service. We are outside since I had my puppy and enjoyed some delicious and authentic German food. I was impressed and can only imagine how packed it gets when October rolls around. I appreciate the true to German nature of the food. No American versions of sausages and plates. Support this place and enjoy a taste of Germany!

Xiang Gourmet is an authentic Hunan restaurant with excellent food that is slightly on the pricier side. They're located right in Center City so the prices are in line with the location.  Portion sizes were large and you could tell the food was higher quality.  I went with a large group so I was able to try a variety of dishes. 

I wouldn't normally order tilapia because it's a bland fish that takes on whatever flavors it's cooked with. However, XG's Whole Tilapia was cooked perfectly and came in a beautiful and bright chili sauce that looked spicier than it actually was. The homemade sticky rice shao mei is an absolute must! So fresh and tasty. I've never had preserved egg before so I jumped at the opportunity to try it. It had a unique mild flavor unlike anything I've had. I really loved it and would order again. Another favorite of mine was the deep fried buns you dip in sweetened condensed milk. They reminded me of beignets; very light and fluffy dough.

My favorite dish was something I normally love to order: diced chicken with chili pepper and peanuts. The peanut flavor really came through in the dish because the peanuts were fried with the chicken.  I also LOVED the spiciness as a lot of other restaurants don't make the chicken itself spicy enough.

The restaurant is beautifully decorated with some really nice design elements. Service was attentive but a few things had to be asked for twice. Highly recommend if you're nearby and don't feel like making the trek to China
The day I tried Ikes it was soo awesome. It blew Port of Subs right out of the water. I go their every day now
This place is a great little spot. Delicious sandwiches and fries. Looking forward to trying everything they have to offer

The food and service here are always at ROCKSTAR LEVEL! I'm very pleased with the quality selection of items they serve. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND THEIR SOUPS! They are the best, the onion rings, omg to die for! Then again, everything is to die for here!

I called on Sunday afternoon to make a 5:30 reservation for my husband's birthday dinner they were fully booked. So we walked in at 5:30 to try our luck and they sat us (party of 5) within 10 mins. The decor and ambiance was so cool including the open flame candle on our table to keep bugs away. I order a martini that was served in a solid ice 'glass'. So cool.
We order the oysters (small but delicious), shrimp cocktail (yummy but 2 of us had to share 1 shrimp since there were only 4). My daughter had the chicken pot pie which had a surprisingly amazing rosemary flavor, my mom had the trout which had ZERO bones, my husband and daughter shared the filet mignon which had an incredible flavor, so tender and an amazing flaming presentation. I had the scallops tostadas which our server suggested I get the seafood kebabs instead to 'get more for our money', but I was so glad I stuck to my gut. I have never had such perfectly cooked, LARGE, scallops. The flavor was incredible. We topped it off with flourless chocolate cake which was magical.

I was craving Thai and this hit the spot just right. Stopped by for lunch and I had the red curry with chicken and hubby had the basil fried rice with beef. The portion sizes are excellent, the amount of protein is perfect and prices are great that's called a great trifecta. Great service, excellent food, great location for people watching enjoy!

Great food...family run... we will definitely be back..The owner chef.. made it special night out.. I had the lasagna and it was one of the best I have had...   Fresh home cooking... nice escape from all the chain places .....

Came here to grab some dessert. Their highlight is their gelato. They have decent selection of flavors maybe 12? I tried a couple of flavors. Definitely well made and presented gelato. I liked the Nutella and tiramisu. Extremely pricey per scoop. I think 2 scoops were 8$? It was tasty but wasn't best gelato I had in my life or anything close to that. Would try their flavors but price not really worth it imo.

Love this place. First off, everything is gluten-free, which makes it the prefect place for my husband (who has celiac) and I to grab a bite to eat. 

There's a lot of variety to build your bowl with. One thing I was surprised to enjoy was the honey sriracha Brussels sprouts. I never ate Brussels sprouts growing up but now I order them almost every time I go. 

I also really like their bbq chicken. Super flavorful! My favorite sauce is the creamy wasabi.

One thing you MUST TRY are the snickerdoodle cookies. They are so soft and delicious. Like fluffy cinnamon clouds!

The only thing I'd suggest is a nutrition guide; it would really be useful got those of us who are trying improve our diet.
Gumbo was really flavorful. Chargrilled oysters were just okay. Service was good and in the heart of the French Quarter shops.

The food was actually good and the portions were plentiful. I definitely did not like the cookie dough dessert. The serve was excellent. I took off a star because the food was not hot enough. It was actually borderline cold.

Hello, I have only written one review in the past. Yesterday evening my family and I went to eat there.  It rained all day, but wonderful weather in the evening.  We were allowed to eat inside due to Covid concerns, and we were given a table outside with wet chairs.  We had to request napkins and then dry it ourselves.  We asked for water with ice an were told that no glass water service as owner is worried about lips touching the glasses and spreading Covid, so plastic 12 ounce water bottle was ordered for $2.50 each (ouch, considering this is 25 cents en-mass).  Then food comes out and we had to wait 8 minutes for them to bring the utensils (food getting cold), only for plastic fork/spoon/knife/napkin combo was given.... really???  Then we clearly explained that we are all vegetarian and defined it further by saying no fish/meat/chicken, only to be told clearly that the Papaya salad was vegetarian... we ordered this only to taste the fish!!  Take it back is what we asked, only to be billed for this at the end.   One would think this place would want to please their customers and be inviting but this was clearly not the case.  I would not ever return here and would not recommend this to my friends!  Sorry, but this is the truth. Owner needs to understand that Covid will not spread if I drink water from a glass and eat from a metal proper utensil.  Owner and chef needs to respect what vegetarian means and truthfully deliver food that is such.

Best doughnuts I've ever had in this city hands down the best in the country. But seriously though they are the best ever. No cards though so I've had to hit the atm across the street multiple times with my dumb ass to get doughnuts

Everything was wonderful as it always is very consistently great. I ordered pizza garlic knots and when I went to pick it up I realized they had special deserts. Let me tell you about the most amazing melt in your mouth heavenly lemoncillo desert I got and enjoyed. I love anything lemon but this was out of this world have to get some in addition to the great pizza and food they have to offer. Thanks for a great nights meal my family loved it. The only thing next time I'm going to get a desert for each person I'm not sharing again.
Absolutely phenomenal!! Highly recommend for breakfast. They have breakfast till they close. I had the Seafood Benedict, and I couldn't have asked for more. Great Chicory coffee as well.

Couldnt believe my luck when I found some good authentic ramen in the area. Their noodles are so good and the add ins are great. Broth is flavorful. Hot the spot on a cold rainy day! Very nice staff and exceptionally clean restaurant. Will be back to try more and sample their sushi!

No bone in wings??? Manager was really a dick about it when asked after purchased. They forgot about our call in order which is okay. Just tell me up front though

Looks like we're headed back to the Westfield location!

I work in Cummins station and this is the perfect spot to get "out of the office" and do some focused work or take a break. Friendly people, great service, great decor. They also have a great lunch menu any time I need to grab a quick lunch. Five stars all around!

What a great spot. Friendly professional service that made me feel truly valued. Came in for an anniversary, I was so surprised at how attentive the service was and how amazing the food is. Would highly recommend.

Knockbox is awesome! I don't know how I didn't discover it sooner. There's a wide selection of pastries and drinks... AND they serve Bassett's ice cream!

There's also a cute outdoor patio and they enforce social distancing pretty well.

They also offer punch cards which is great for those who go regularly.

I will definitely get a pastry next time I get coffee here.
Best hot dog's in the universe! Great service and exceptional food. I've heard there were better hot dogs, but I've never had one. Curbside pickup or dine outside.

the staff was super rude when I asked a worker in the back patio about an order that was made through doordash, he said i had to call, when I had already dialed twice, when i call again finally answered me and were just rude. very bad service
Amazing food! My favorites to get out the ribs, corn fritters, and fresh cut fries! And you can't forget about their dessert! So good! Can't beat it!

We went to mother's ruin on a Tuesday night and to say it was memorable would be an understatement. First we talked with the bartender about the slushee du jour and she was so kind to bring me a sample! It was the slushees last day and that was probably for the best.. it has so much ginger every sip was like a throat punch. Instead I opted for the Chasing the Puck and my friend got buff Richard. My drink was delicious, it reminded me of a better and more upscale vodka cran honestly. Possibly due to the full moon, the other costumers that night were WILD. The staff couldn't have handled it better truly, they were awesome. All while we were there they had to handle a fight, a phone thrown at my friend, and a girl who stole two beers and left her credit card (lol). After each incidence someone would come over and apologize while promising it's never been so crazy there. It was nice having someone acknowledge all the crazy things that were happened instead of trying to ignore it. All of the bartenders and waiters were so kind and friendly, which can be hard to find at these trendy bars. Our bartender even did a tequila shot with us at the end of the night to apologize for all the drama! I was seriously so impressed with how well they handled the chaos. I will totally return for the friendly, fun bartenders and good drinks. Oh, also do yourself a favor in go into BOTH bathrooms to admire the art. I was nearly brought to my knees with laughter!

Went for dinner with my daughter. We always had great food and service in the past. Tonight was not a good night there. The staff was more interested in talking to their friends at other tables than providing us with service. After 10 minutes the waitress came over (they were not busy) she took our drink order and we placed an appetizer order, letting her know that we will be ordering dinner as well. Our app was dropped off at the table and the waitress walked away to go speak to her friends- no plates no silverware. Waited 20 minutes for the waitress to come take our order and informed us it was last call for food and drinks. We were not offered dessert or anything. The rest of the evening was not a good one.
One of the best places in an area full of competition. The food quality is good, sustainable and the service is very good.

I walked in, my whole family noticed it smelled like a dirty bathroom. Smelled like pee. We walked right out. I dont understand how the other people did not care or realize. Please do not waste your time, listen to these reviews. Go to an ihop thats ten minutes away, that wont kill your nostrils.

Second  time here, ordered the monster BBQ burger.  (Burger, brisket, bacon, Bbq sauce)  I think there was a burger under all of the brisket!
Wife had the philly cheese burger.  Looked huge as well, sides were great as well.
Overall a great experience!
Absolutely delicious options! Comfy creative decor! Nice staff. Delicious coffee!

I love this restaurant! I live near by and it's great to have a quality Chinese place in the neighborhood. Very friendly, helpful and passionate staff. Food is very very good. I recommend the orange chicken!
Ate there years ago and stumbled upon by chance. Still remember the vegan cheesesteak being of richer flavor and better than the real thing, which I had one that day aswell.
Taco really good, as was the fountain drink. They replaced part of an order for me. Friendly and cheap. Seemed pretty clean. Fast service. Not crowded, pre covid.

We loved this place! My husband and I were on vacation this week in Nashville and needed a good breakfast before exploring the town. This was the closest place so we gave it a shot. Ended up going back the next two mornings making it 3 days in a row! The staff is very friendly and the food is fantastic! Where else can you get 2 perfect eggs over easy, 2 pieces of bacon, 2 hash brown triangles AND two biscuits with gravy for $6.99? One morning I tried the pancakes and they were huge and so fluffy. One morning we had a late start, 10:45, so my husband went for a double cheeseburger and it was huge and perfectly cooked. It gets busy in waves but we were able to get in and out in less than 30 minutes each day. We witnessed many takeout orders if you call ahead or take it with you.
What a find!

I would like to give zero stars. This place was founded on racism and unfortunately I found out after my trip to New Orleans . They are pro murdering Black people with a history of giving a free ham to white people who lynched black people. They're food is as bland as you can imagine. Maybe they should take cooking lessons from
Black people and stop promoting the murder of black people. But really they should go out of business as they are not good to society or your tastebuds.

Very good! We started with a shrimp cocktail appetizer which was awesome! I had a Blinkers Steak that my husband ended up finishing what I couldn't eat so there was nothing left it was so good! He had the Blackened Shrimp also nothing left!

I tried the brunch buffet on a Sunday after church. They seated us right away which was great since it was very busy. The brunch buffet was kind of sad, just lime a typical nice hotel breakfast, nothing unique. I assume their menu items must be better since this is such a popular place.

We were up in the Ardmore area and my wife found this Italian gourmet market. From the outside it was pretty unassuming but when entering our eyes lit up. So much tasty looking morsels everywhere. It was like a food treasure hunt. 
We decided to grab a hot lunch here and split it. We also grabbed some stuff for dinner later. I will have to say every single thing we ate, down to the deserts was spectacular and beyond our expectations. 
Everything was fresh and quality. We will definitely make our way back again even though it's so far out of our way, it was awesome and beyond worth it.

Average. Cute atmosphere but not enough room to really manoeuvre around the tables. You order your food at the counter. The eggs benny waffle comes with a salad which I think is a bit odd. It was $4 to switch the salad to hash browns. The hollandaise is very lemony. Nothing about the dish was bad but it also wasn't amazing- which is why I'm giving 3 stars. I personally won't be going back because it's just average.

I called this place a week before coming to the city and they said that reservations weren't being taken at that time and not needed. 
We arrived and there was an hour wait. They should really think about adding some way to make a reservation for their guests. 
We stayed at the bar for a bit to have a drink and come up with a new game plan.  
I hope the next review I write is about the food more.
It may not look great but their food is delicious and plentiful . My husband who is not easily won over , ate his entire order and then looked at mine, super good

Had dinner here tonight...best schnitzel I have ever had...and my mom is German!  I travel to Germany!  Great food including the spatzel and red cabbage.  Apple strudel was served warm with whip cream...delicious.  Service was also great, attentive but not intrusive.  Will definitely eat here again.

I'm in awe with the new service that this place offers. Contact free ordering. As you can see in my attached photo you scan the barcode on your phone, a link will appear and your free to order as many time as you please. Once its process you can pay with your card and it gives you options to order more if you please. The service was fast, all staff wears a mask and gloves. The food was definitely delicious and omg please do try their drinks it is amazing.

Best asian food in the area.  We have ordered from here on many occasions an always have a good meal. Cannot say much about sushi, because we don't eat bate, but the general tso's, chicken and broccoli, pepper steak, sweet sour and the spare ribs are the best.  We keep saying we are going to try the sit down.  Hopefully this year.

I really enjoyed the experience at this hidden treasure. The way the restaurant was set up really took me back to a time I spent in Venice, from the entrance, to the waitresses outfit, service and wine. 

We ordered the clams and mussels as an appetizer served with marinera sauce, it was delicious and served with toasted bread. Unfortunately, the bread was a bit too hard on both the appetizer and the meal.  I also ordered one of their specials, shrimp and scallops on pasta with no Alfredo (lactose intolerant) they did give me an alternative, but it was a bit too dry, perhaps due to the missing component of Alfredo sauce. 

This place definitely had the charm of Italy, and the wine pairings on point but the food was not as exquisite.
This is the second time out of the total of two times I have eat here that they've put no meat in the crunch wrap supreme. I had to eat my nachos with a fork.

I never leave reviews, but I had to for the sake of this new restaurant. Went here last night for my partner's birthday, and it was one the best meals I've had in the Tampa Bay Area! Probably now my favorite restaurant. We had almost every appetizer on the menu, and for our meals: the octopus and the blue crap spaghetti. Will definitely return.

Let me start by saying my husband and I placed an order for an anti pasta salad  and a quesadilla. We live close to the restaurant so delivery was quick. I asked for romaine lettuce  and they brought me iceberg.  I called and they said the would bring it. It never came. I called the store the three times the staff literally hung up on me. They also have a habit of putting you on hold without you knowledge.  Harendis costumer service, now I know why you have two stars. Your staff suck and they are rude. Consider training or get new staff. Forgot to mention  I asked for a manager and the female staff said" I'm not giving you my name" I said I am asking for your managers name. She hung up on me. Again, such poor customer service.  You won't have to worries about me ordering fro Cityview again.

Don't order here on a weekend for takeout.  They don't know how to manage getting the food prepared and ready on time.  Waited 55 mins to have them tell me they gave my order to someone else.  2nd bad experience over the past 6 weeks.  Might be the last time we order takeout from here.

We went New Year's Eve with a reservation for 7.  They sat us at a table for 6 .  Manager noticed right away and made an extra effort to move us to a bigger table.  She succeeded.  The food was delicious and serve was excellent.  We definitely returning.

Great brunch spot. We tried the new seasonal items including the donut holes and they were so good! I also had the new carnitas burrito and oh it was good. First watch has been one of our favorite places for breakfast wether it's here, in Oklahoma, or vacationing in Florida.

Ill stay at a high level. It is less expensive than some higher end chains but is priced a little high for what you get. The meats are at best choice grade from what I can tell. No prime, no angus. I don't think or at least they don't taste like they were cooked over wood or wood smoke. The salad bar had no desert and the one fruit option was unskinned, uncored dirty pineapple slices. Basically to discourage anyone from eating any. No potato salad. The only regular bread in the restaurant was a pile of slices community style on a platter next to the salad bar where every customer handles it and the rest would not... even with a ten foot pole. The waiters should serve the bread with the cheesy rolls just for hygiene purposes. The traffic mgmt would be improved by having a few less tables in the right places. Nobody is paying attention to rotating which section of the restaurant is getting what cuts hot off the grill. And the variety is sirloin, sirloin, sirloin, sirloin, picanha (only available one paper thin slice at a time), sirloin, sirloin, chicken, sirloin, chorizo, sirloin, caballo (once in 90 minutes), sirloin. And this is not prime sirloin cooked over wood. I didn't mind trying it out but don't see myself returning. It would be good for parties of 6 and whatnot. Kind of festive.

This place gets 5 stars from me and here's why.  Strikes you a small, dive-ish, eating spot.  But two things: the service and the food.  Friendliest people work here who want you to have the best experience throughout your whole visit, and you can feel it.  The burritos are off the wall here, bonus points for making a traditional California burrito, which are exclusive to San Diego.. haven't had one since living there. Next visit to Tampa, have to go again, no question!

Just ate here 10 mins ago the buidling is nice and the waitress Erica was sweet, kind and her service was on time now to the food if thats what we are calling it I ate there 10 mins ago...and now my stomach is upset. I ordered four cheese shrimp fettuccine, it was very bland, and the bread they gave before the meal cold and hard terrible. My husband had avocado toast and it was bland, hard toast and now he has a toothache and stomachache..thanks for and expensive experience..we definitely wont ever be back...oh yeah we are New orleans natives and know our culture this restaurant is not for cultured and has NO FLAVA LIKE THE CITY ITS IN

We discovered this place in May while spending a week at the Ritz-Carlton (their food was mediocre and overpriced). So we came to the nearest town by Santa Barbara and found Naan Stop. Their food are authentic, mango lassi and masala chai is to die for. Everything is so delicious. The owner is so kind and down to earth , he takes pride in his business and customers. If you are in the area you should try this place. We drove two and a half hours to get to this place and it is well worth it.

This place is amazing! The flavor combinations will blow your mind. It is so hard to pick one dish when coming here. The decoration in this restaurant is so fun and colorful, it makes me feel happy! The service is efficient and the servers are knowledgeable about the menu which is very helpful if unfamiliar with a dish or words. Everything is so good and the portions are large. We had enough left over for another full meal the next day. The restaurant has great parking out back. Try out this place the next time you are in the area!

This restaurant was recommended by several friends so we met our son here for a holiday dinner.
The entrance and parking are behind the building.  We didn't know that so had a walk since we parked in front.
Our waitress was friendly and checked on us during the meal.
The bread was light and delicious.  We didn't care for the spicy oil dip so we asked our waitress for butter.

The roasted beet salad was wonderfully presented and had a little kick to it.  It is complimented with goat cheese fritters, which helped cool down the dressing.
My husband had the blackened mahi-mahi with black bean cucumber salsa, which he enjoyed even though it was spiced more than he would normally like it.
I had the rib-eye steak, perfectly prepared and topped with a delicious herb butter.  The steak is huge and I brought half of it home to enjoy later.  It was served with garlic mashed potatoes and green beans.
Topped it all off with warm creme brûlée - so good!

Tables are spaced out and masks were worn by all.  Hand sanitizer available on your way out.

I have been here once before but I decided to pop in today because I was actually waiting in a long line for a rapid coronavirus test. And before anyone gets concerned the test results were negative hahaha. Since it was going to be about an hour and a half to two hour wait and I woke up without having my daily coffee I decided to pop over and get a chicken biscuit. Plus it's only made sense to blurred because the next day I decided that I was going to get back to healthy eating after a whole week of splurging. I order just a plain fried chicken biscuit and coffee to go. I wish I could have placed a 4-star because the service was amazing and the food was good but definitely not the best chicken biscuit that I've had. I also ordered a side of their Maple sausage balls which were pretty good as well. There are definitely other items on the menu that I think would be a little bit tastier but just a little something to go this was pretty good. I would still come back here in or something else in the menu and again the lovely service definitely makes everything fun.

Your Place is hands down the best more traditional Thai food restaurant in Santa Barbara. The staff are all so kind and sweet.

We have had a few things on the menu but hands down the best item is the Pineapple Curry, id recommend getting it at least medium spicy. And don't forget to order rice with it as it doesn't come with rice. Seriously go order this now, you won't regret it!!
